text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're onto the homestretch! Let's see
what
they've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O rushes forward with
incredible
force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The audience at Kyoto Racecourse is
roaring with
cheers.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! I hope you enjoyed the
opening
act!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A solo won't be enough, a duo is too
few, and a
trio just won't suffice.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do you understand? No, you already knew, didn't you? I'm talking to you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's you I've been waiting for. You and
you alone...
are the fourth actor in this
epic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I return to the academy with Admire
Vega after
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There, I notice a familiar voice coming
from the
track.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She's still wearing her uniform... Guess
that's just
her being forgetful.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll get changed first, obviously, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I run for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like the moment a water droplet hits a
surface,
Admire Vega's eyes grow wide
as she watches
Meisho Doto running in
her uniform.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can't look away—her gaze is
unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's filled with the sudden urge to dash
off
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega heads off, giving in to her
impulses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her tail sways in the moonlight, its silver
glow
highlighting her silhouette.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In this moment, everything about her is
beautiful,
vivid, and vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I knew Admire Vega would be difficult...
but
Opera O was incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I can get way better than I am now!
